## Gates

`just check` runs `ops-check`, `ops-docs check`, `tasks check`, the generated-block
checker, and Python compilation checks. Run `python3 tools/check-projects-block`
from the repository root; its target and index lookup are root-relative. It checks
staged `instructions/AGENTS.md` when changed in the index, otherwise the working copy.

Use `just test-one tools/test_check_projects_block.py -k staged` for the staged-content
cases. `just test-fast` and `just test` both run all tests in `tools/`; there is no
affected-only selection. The pre-push hook carries the full suite; there is no CI.

## Layout

- `instructions/AGENTS.md`: the global file, served to every harness home through
  tack `./links.toml`. Root `AGENTS.md` is this repository's guide.
- `profiles/`: the personal, work and external fragments resolved by ops-profile.
- `skills/`: seven vendored skills, `skills/references/` and the skill README.
- `vendor/superpowers`: the pinned submodule; `just setup` initializes it.
- `.skill-lock.json`: skill source metadata. `bin/skill-sizes.py`: the inventory utility.
- `docs/notes/`: eight dated briefs. `docs/`: coding advice and the provenance audit.
  `docs/archive/`: the former Codex instructions. `docs/specs/` and `docs/plans/`:
  the profiles documents and this extraction's design and plan.
- `tools/check-projects-block`: the generated-block checker and adjacent tests.
  `tools/` also holds vendored ops tooling; `tasks/` holds task records.

## Rules

- `instructions/AGENTS.md` is the global file every session loads; root `AGENTS.md`
  is this repository's guide. Writing a rule into the wrong file puts it in front of
  every session, or in front of none.
- The Projects and Feedback-owners blocks in `instructions/AGENTS.md` are generated
  by ops `ops-projects` and checked by `tools/check-projects-block`. Hand edits are
  refused because the next run of just projects in ops would silently undo them.
- Keep `vendor/superpowers` at the release Claude Code's installed plugin runs
  (`~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json`). A bump that adds or removes a skill
  needs a commit here and a declaration in tack `./links.toml`, or harnesses run
  different skills.
